metadata.coverage: USGS NHD large-scale waterbodies, flowlines and water areas intersecting the three counties. Geometry clipped to the map county boundaries. Full source pagination checked. Not a complete wetlands, floodplain, groundwater or utility-service inventory.
metadata.precision: Coordinates rounded to six decimals at download; topology-preserving simplification of 0.00001 degrees. Screening geometry, not a survey.
